metadata.coverage_preamble: The day holds the almanac line, church, dinner, the Candlemas letter, and a few words after the house was quiet.

yesterday: The letter is written. The carrier is Thursday. The twins are ten, and the paper says so.
The loaf was a penny, and a finger short of the notch.
You are mended of the cold. The comedy is done. Lent waits until you know the day.
Tomorrow Titus is at the Cross Keys at two, and you are in it. The Rose bills Siege of London.
